description: This C# source file defines the internal class 'AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory' which implements the 'IQueueAdapterFactory' interface. The class is responsible for creating and managing AdoNet queue adapters, including handling queries, cache, and stream queue mapping within an Orleans streaming extension using AdoNet.
